title: refactor: forward Perplexity search options as-is and bill the tier from the response
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes the `web_search_options` normalization from `gen.pollinations.ai/src/text/handler.ts`: no more 400 for `medium`, no pinning of `high` on the Pro models, no stripping for non-search models. The option is forwarded untouched.
- Each Sonar model now carries one request-fee rule per size at Perplexity's list prices (Sonar 5/8/12, Pro and Reasoning Pro 6/10/14 per 1K). The rule that bills is the size the response reports, else the size the caller asked for (OpenRouter reports only a total), else low.
- Drops the `searchContextSizes` registry field. Track records the caller's requested size as the pricing input; existing rule ids for low/high stay, so Tinybird `adjustment_costs` keys are unchanged.
- Tests: gen `generation-vcr` (full file), `static-provider-fallbacks`, `fallback`, `tracking-observability`, `modelResolver`; enter `pricing-data`. `tsc` and biome clean for both workers.

Supersedes #14756.

gist.headline: Search sizes, untrimmed
gist.blurb: Perplexity search settings now travel through the hive exactly as requested. The receipt follows the response size, because apparently APIs can know what they did after doing it.
gist.summary: Perplexity Sonar requests now forward `web_search_options` unchanged—including `medium` and search settings on non-search models—and bill Sonar, Sonar Pro, and Sonar Reasoning Pro from the response-reported context size, falling back to the requested size or `low`.
gist.impact: Developers can use Perplexity's full search-size options without handler-side rewriting or 400 responses, while usage tracking selects the matching 5/8/12 or 6/10/14-per-1K size rule from the completed response when available.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Perplexity search options as three labeled seed packets—low, medium, and high—being passed intact through a cozy garden terminal. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully carries the packets to a CRT monitor robot displaying a completed Sonar search result and a small size-aware receipt; code-vines and flowers make the forwarding and tracking feel organic rather than bureaucratic.
